messages:
Alex Morgan: Heads-up: supplier notified backlog on run MNL-2405. 9 racks held for quality sampling; ETA unknown until vendor QC signs off. Affects reservations RES-100210 (marketplace demo) and RES-100211 (private EU).
Priya Nair: Oof. How many racks total and what SKU?
Alex Morgan: 9 racks, SKU rtx-s2-rack. Marketplace demo needs 3, private needs 5, 1 is spare.
Daniel Ortiz: Can we take from Dedicated float? DED-7542 has 6 available in EU pool but that reduces committed throughput.
Jules Kim: If we pull from DED we must update customer entitlements & issue credits. Not ideal but possible for short window.
Orion Logistics Rep: Vendor QC rule: sampling 10% per batch, takes 48-72h. We can request accelerated sample release for 4 racks if labelled "partner-demo"; fee applies.
Priya Nair: Options on table: (A) Accelerate 4 racks (costly), (B) Swap 3 demo racks from DED pool -> marketplace and backfill later, (C) Delay demo. Which keeps SLAs best?
Daniel Ortiz: We should avoid delaying demo. Proposal: move 3 racks from DED->RES-100210, accelerate 4 racks for private (pay contingency), leave 2 delayed.
Alex Morgan: Cost question: finance ok to bill acceleration to contingency? PartnerOpsBot: Auto-action: create capacity-swap CS-9533 and acceleration request ACC-2120.
Finance-Bot: Pre-approval needed for ACC-2120. Please attach estimated delta.
Jules Kim: I'll compute prorated credits for DED customers if we borrow 3 racks. Need ETA for vendor acceleration.
Orion Logistics Rep: If acceleration confirmed now, vendor can release 4 racks in ~36h. Ground arrival to EU DC +2 days after release.
Priya Nair: That should keep private's canary on schedule if we do accelerate. Daniel, confirm DED pool can afford 3 racks for up to 5 days.
Daniel Ortiz: Confirmed: DED buffer can spare 3 racks for 72h with minimal TPS impact; beyond that we degrade to 90% throughput.
Alex Morgan: OK final plan: (1) Borrow 3 racks from DED to satisfy marketplace demo (RES-100210). (2) Approve ACC-2120 to accelerate 4 racks for private (RES-100211) charged to contingency. (3) Document fallback if vendor delay >7d.
Priya Nair: I'll open customer comms drafts: marketplace note (short ETA update) and private note (assurance + tracking). Share for legal review.
Jules Kim: I'll run the billing proration and post numbers in ~30m. PartnerOpsBot: CS-9533 & ACC-2120 created and assigned to Alex, Jules, and Orion.
Finance-Bot: Pre-approval request posted. Need cost estimate before final sign-off.
Daniel Ortiz: I'll update canary schedule and add a holdback flag on DED routes.
Orion Logistics Rep: Will confirm accelerated manifest and provide serial ranges when available.
Alex Morgan: Thanks — keep updates here. If vendor pushes longer than 72h we revert and notify customers. :memo:
